result.question: Why did the Arameans think the king of Israel had hired the kings of the Hittites and Egyptians to attack them?

readings.answer: Because the Lord caused them to hear the sound of chariots, horses, and a great army.
readings.support: For the Lord had caused the Arameans to hear the sound of chariots, horses, and a great army, so that they said

readings.answer: Because they heard the sound of chariots, horses, and a great army.
readings.support: to hear the sound of chariots, horses, and a great army, so that they said to one another

assessments.reason: It explicitly matches the verse’s causal statement: “For the Lord had caused the Arameans to hear the sound of chariots, horses, and a great army, so that they said…”

It gives the immediate cause stated in the text—hearing the sounds—though it omits the agent (“the Lord”) who caused the hearing; the passage links their conclusion to the hearing (“so that they said”).
